fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: the mapped property type is Nullable<T>
fields.trigger: an enum-backed-integral or simple-value output parameter expression is built for that property
fields.response: call the provider's nullable get-method (nullableGetMethodName) instead of its standard get-method (getMethodName) to retrieve the output parameter's value
fields.postcondition: only the enum-backed-integral and simple-value output-parameter builders accept a nullableGetMethodName; the string, binary and array output-parameter builders call a single get-method regardless of the property's nullability
